hotel_info.name: KPR Hotel
hotel_info.tagline: Authentic South Indian Hospitality & Madurai Culinary Heritage Since 1998
hotel_info.description: KPR Hotel is a celebrated hospitality institution renowned for premium hotel accommodations, authentic Madurai and Chettinad culinary delicacies, woodfire Seeraga Samba biryanis, crispy ghee roast dosas, and world-class guest services.

timings.check_in: 12:00 PM (Early check-in from 9:00 AM subject to availability)
timings.check_out: 11:00 AM (Late check-out until 2:00 PM upon request)

service_options: Dine-in Restaurant with Live Seating Map
Outdoor & Bulk Catering for 20 to 1,000+ guests
payment_methods: UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, QR code)
Credit Cards & Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay)

delivery_policy.fee: ₹30 flat delivery fee; FREE delivery for orders above ₹300

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 24 hours prior to check-in date. Late cancellations incur 1 night charge.
policies.id_proof: Valid Government Photo ID (Aadhaar, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving License) is mandatory for all adult guests at check-in.
policies.children: Children up to 6 years stay free when sharing existing bedding.
policies.pets: Pets are not allowed on property; service/guide dogs are warmly welcome.
policies.smoking: All rooms are 100% non-smoking; designated smoking areas are available outdoors.

signature_dishes: Madurai Mutton Kari Dosa (₹280) - Crispy dosa layered with tender minced mutton keema & eggs
Seeraga Samba Chicken Biryani (₹220) - Traditional brass deg woodfire cooked aromatic biryani
Royal Seeraga Samba Mutton Biryani (₹320) - Fragrant biryani with succulent tender mutton chunks
Crispy Ghee Roast Dosa (₹110) - Golden thin fermented rice crepe roasted with pure desi ghee
South Indian Veg Meals Thali (₹150) - Unlimited rice, sambar, rasam, kootu, poriyal, appalam, curd
Spiced Chicken 65 (₹190) - Deep fried crispy boneless chicken tossed with curry leaves and spices
Chilled Madurai Jigarthanda (₹80) - Famous almond gum, nannari syrup, basundi milk & ice cream drink
Kumbakonam Degree Filter Coffee (₹40) - Freshly brewed chicory blend with frothy whole cow milk

dietary_and_spice.vegetarian: Separate dedicated pure vegetarian kitchen section preparing pure veg dosas, idlis, thali meals, paneer dishes, and snacks.
dietary_and_spice.halal: All meats sourced are 100% Halal certified and prepared fresh daily.

table_booking_info.booking_rules: No advance booking fees required. Grace period is 15 minutes past the reserved slot time. Tables can be booked anytime for Lunch (12:30 PM & 1:30 PM) or Dinner (7:30 PM & 8:30 PM).
